# Calculate Reversibility Index

```{r}
#| label: calculate-reversibility

# Calculate warming and recovery responses for each posterior draw.
# Changes are corrected for concurrent temporal changes in the stable treatment.
# Reversibility is the difference between the corrected warming and recovery
# responses.

compute_reversibility <- function(draws_df) {

  draws_df %>%
    group_by(.draw) %>%
    summarise(

      # Change during warming
      warming_change =
        mean(.epred[Temperature == "Warming" & Day == 14]) -
        mean(.epred[Temperature == "Warming" & Day == 7]),

      # Change during cooling
      cooling_change =
        mean(.epred[Temperature == "Recovery" & Day == 28]) -
        mean(.epred[Temperature == "Recovery" & Day == 21]),

      # Corresponding change in the stable treatment during warming
      stable_warming =
        mean(.epred[Temperature == "Stable" & Day == 14]) -
        mean(.epred[Temperature == "Stable" & Day == 7]),

      # Corresponding change in the stable treatment during cooling
      stable_cooling =
        mean(.epred[Temperature == "Stable" & Day == 28]) -
        mean(.epred[Temperature == "Stable" & Day == 21]),

      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      warming_corrected =
        warming_change - stable_warming,

      cooling_corrected =
        cooling_change - stable_cooling,

      reversibility =
        cooling_corrected - warming_corrected
    )
}
```

# Base Model (Figure 2)
##Create Prediction Grid

```{r}
newdata_base <- expand.grid(
  Temperature = c("Stable", "Warming", "Recovery"),
  Day = c(7, 14, 21, 28),
  Jar = NA,
  re_formula = NA
)
```

###Bacterial Abundance

```{r}
draws_abundance <- fit_bact_base %>%
  epred_draws(
    newdata = newdata_base,
    re_formula = NA
  )

contrast_abundance <- compute_reversibility(
  draws_abundance
) %>%
  mutate(metric = "Bacterial abundance")
```

###Bacterial Diversity
```{r}
draws_shannon <- fit_shannon_base %>%
  epred_draws(
    newdata = newdata_base,
    re_formula = NA
  )

contrast_shannon <- compute_reversibility(
  draws_shannon
) %>%
  mutate(metric = "Shannon diversity")
```

### Bacterial Composition
```{r}
draws_beta <- fit_beta_base %>%
  epred_draws(
    newdata = newdata_base,
    re_formula = NA
  )

contrast_beta <- compute_reversibility(
  draws_beta
) %>%
  mutate(metric = "Beta diversity")
```
### Algal Abundance
```{r}
draws_algae <- fit_algae_base %>%
  epred_draws(
    newdata = newdata_base,
    re_formula = NA
  )

contrast_algae <- compute_reversibility(
  draws_algae
) %>%
  mutate(metric = "Algal abundance")

```

### Combine posterior reversibility distributions

```{r}
reversibility_df <- bind_rows(
  contrast_abundance,
  contrast_shannon,
  contrast_beta,
  contrast_algae
)
```

##Spider Plot 

```{r}
## Spider Plot

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Standardize reversibility within each response variable
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Response variables occur on different measurement scales.
# Reversibility is standardized by the posterior SD within each response
# so that responses can be displayed on a common scale.

radar_draws <- reversibility_df %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  mutate(
    reversibility_std =
      reversibility / sd(reversibility, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Summarize posterior distributions
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

radar_df <- radar_draws %>%
  mutate(
    metric = factor(
      metric,
      levels = c(
        "Bacterial abundance",
        "Shannon diversity",
        "Beta diversity",
        "Algal abundance"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  summarise(
    RI_median = median(
      reversibility_std,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    RI_low = quantile(
      reversibility_std,
      0.05,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    RI_high = quantile(
      reversibility_std,
      0.95,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Spider-plot axes
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

axis_df <- data.frame(
  metric = factor(
    c(
      "Bacterial abundance",
      "Shannon diversity",
      "Beta diversity",
      "Algal abundance"
    ),
    levels = c(
      "Bacterial abundance",
      "Shannon diversity",
      "Beta diversity",
      "Algal abundance"
    )
  ),

  metric_label = c(
    "Bacterial\nabundance",
    "Bacterial\ndiversity",
    "Bacterial\ncomposition",
    "Algal\nabundance"
  ),

  angle = c(
    pi / 2,
    pi,
    0,
    3 * pi / 2
  )
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Common radial scale
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

axis_min <- -2
axis_max <- 3

radar_df <- radar_df %>%
  left_join(
    axis_df,
    by = "metric"
  ) %>%
  arrange(angle) %>%
  mutate(
    r_plot =
      (RI_median - axis_min) /
      (axis_max - axis_min),

    x = r_plot * cos(angle),
    y = r_plot * sin(angle)
  )


# Close polygon
radar_closed <- radar_df %>%
  arrange(angle) %>%
  bind_rows(slice(., 1))


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Spider-plot grid
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

grid_levels <- seq(
  0.2,
  1,
  by = 0.2
)

grid_closed <- expand.grid(
  r_plot = grid_levels,
  angle = axis_df$angle
) %>%
  mutate(
    x = r_plot * cos(angle),
    y = r_plot * sin(angle)
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    r_plot,
    angle
  ) %>%
  group_by(r_plot) %>%
  bind_rows(
    slice(., 1)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Fixed radar scale

axis_min <- -2
axis_max <- 3

# Spider plot colors
text_col <- "black"
grid_col <- "#EAF2FA"

# Radial axis lines
axis_lines <- axis_df %>%
  tidyr::crossing(
    r_plot = c(0, 1)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    x = r_plot * cos(angle),
    y = r_plot * sin(angle)
  )


# Zero-reversibility reference polygon
zero_grid <- expand.grid(
  r_plot =
    (0 - axis_min) /
    (axis_max - axis_min),

  angle = axis_df$angle
) %>%
  mutate(
    x = r_plot * cos(angle),
    y = r_plot * sin(angle)
  ) %>%
  arrange(angle) %>%
  bind_rows(
    slice(., 1)
  )
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 8

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Spider Plot - Base Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

base_spider <- ggplot() +

  geom_path(
    data = grid_closed,
    aes(x = x, y = y, group = r_plot),
    color = grid_col,
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +

  geom_line(
    data = axis_lines,
    aes(x = x, y = y, group = metric),
    color = grid_col,
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +

  geom_path(
    data = zero_grid,
    aes(x = x, y = y),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8,
    linetype = "11"
  ) +

  geom_text(
    data = data.frame(
      x = 0.42,
      y = -0.18,
      label = "RI = 0"
    ),
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
    color = "black",
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold",
    angle = 45
  ) +

  geom_path(
    data = radar_closed,
    aes(x = x, y = y),
    color = "#4D4D4D",
    linewidth = 2,
    linejoin = "round"
  ) +

  geom_text(
    data = axis_df,
    aes(
      x = 1.23 * cos(angle),
      y = 1.23 * sin(angle),
      label = metric_label
    ),
    size = 10,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = text_col,
    lineheight = 0.85
  ) +

  coord_equal(
    xlim = c(-1.45, 1.45),
    ylim = c(-1.45, 1.45),
    clip = "off"
  ) +

  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +

  theme_void(base_size = 18) +

  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(40, 40, 40, 40)
  )

base_spider
```
## Posterior Probability Distributions 

```{r}
# ---- Panel B: cooling scenario probabilities ----

metric_levels <- c(
  "Bacterial abundance",
  "Shannon diversity",
  "Beta diversity",
  "Algal abundance"
)

# Combine posterior draws across response variables
plot_cat_df <- bind_rows(
  contrast_abundance,
  contrast_shannon,
  contrast_beta,
  contrast_algae
)

# Tolerance used to classify approximately zero or complete reversal
tol <- 0.05

tol <- 0.05

plot_cat_df <- plot_cat_df %>%
  mutate(
    RI_category = case_when(

      abs(cooling_corrected) <
        tol * abs(warming_corrected) ~
        "No recovery",

      abs(warming_corrected + cooling_corrected) <
        tol * abs(warming_corrected) ~
        "Complete reversibility",

      (warming_corrected - cooling_corrected) < 0 ~
        "Overcompensation",

      sign(cooling_corrected) != sign(warming_corrected) &
        abs(cooling_corrected) < abs(warming_corrected) ~
        "Partial recovery",

      TRUE ~
        "Compounding"
    )
  )

ri_levels <- c(
  "Compounding",
  "No recovery",
  "Partial recovery",
  "Complete reversibility",
  "Overcompensation"
)

ri_colors_cb <- c(
  "Compounding"            = "#0B4A8B",
  "No recovery"            = "#5E90E8",
  "Partial recovery"       = "#1AB5A8",
  "Complete reversibility" = "#D8C93C",
  "Overcompensation"       = "#9ACD00"
)
```

```{r}
# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Calculate Posterior Probability of each recovery scenario
# ----------------------------------------------------------

prob_df <- plot_cat_df %>%
  count(metric, RI_category) %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  mutate(
    prob = n / sum(n)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    metric = factor(
      metric,
      levels = metric_levels
    ),
    RI_category = factor(
      RI_category,
      levels = ri_levels
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(metric),
    !is.na(RI_category)
  )

# ----------------------------
# Plot Formatting
# ----------------------------

bar_width <- 0.7

boundary_df <- prob_df %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  summarise(
    y_boundary =
      sum(prob[RI_category == "Overcompensation"]),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    x_num = as.numeric(metric),
    x_start = x_num - bar_width / 2,
    x_end = x_num + bar_width / 2
  )

scale_x_discrete(
  labels = c(
    "Bacterial abundance" = "Bacterial\nAbundance",
    "Shannon diversity"   = "Bacterial\nDiversity",
    "Beta diversity"      = "Bacterial\nComposition",
    "Algal abundance"     = "Algal\nAbundance"
  )
)

```

```{r}
# -------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot Posterior Probabilities Recovery Scenarios - Base Model
# -------------------------------------------------------------

base_panel_B <- ggplot(prob_df, aes(x = metric, y = prob, fill = RI_category)) +
  geom_col(
    width = bar_width
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = boundary_df,
    aes(
      x = x_start,
      xend = x_end,
      y = y_boundary,
      yend = y_boundary
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "#D8C93C",
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = ri_colors_cb,
    breaks = ri_levels
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c(
      "Abundance" = "Bacterial\nAbundance",
      "Shannon"   = "Bacterial\nDiversity",
      "Beta"      = "Bacterial\nComposition",
      "Algae"     = "Algal\nAbundance"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Probability",
    fill = "Recovery Scenario"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(
      size = 20,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.position = "none",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 18,
      face = "bold",
      angle = 30,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 1
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 30),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      size = 24,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(1, "lines"),
    panel.spacing.y = unit(3, "lines"),
    plot.background = element_rect(
      fill = "transparent",
      color = NA
    ),
    panel.background = element_rect(
      fill = "transparent",
      color = NA
    )
  )

base_panel_B
```
